title: Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning Methods for Nonstationary Environments. Towards a Survey of the State of the Art
text: is a clear trend in the research we studied, we are not aware of any work that explicitly specified the speed of adjustment as a safety constraint. At the same time, adjustment speed is extremely important for safety-critical applications, and we believe that in the future, adjustment speed can be considered as a part of safety for COSRL methods. In this work, we provided a review and taxonomy of the state-of-the-art COSR algorithms. We discussed some of the challenges for designing continual learning safe online algorithms and provided a categorization of the safety constraints that can work best for COSRL methods. Based on our survey, we considered existing trends in the research and possible directions for future research in COSRL. Solving this problem would allow much wider acceptance of COSR in safety-critical applications.
